whenToUse: One-time codes: 2FA sign-in, SMS verification, email codes, payment confirmation.
Auto-submit when all digits are entered.
avoidWhen: Passwords or general text — use Input.
Long recovery codes — use a plain Input.
a11y: One real input underneath: SMS autofill (autocomplete=one-time-code) and screen readers work.
Wrong-code errors are announced and keep focus in the field.
